t: You're looking at Covent Garden tube station, on the corner of Long Acre and James Street. The street-level concourse is a Grade II listed building. The station sits on the Piccadilly line between Leicester Square and Holborn, in fare zone 1. It was designed by Leslie Green, the architect behind many of the Underground's central London stations in the early twentieth century. His signature look is here: oxblood red glazed blocks, pillars, and semicircular windows on the first floor, with patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
